text.en:
Darjah Utama Temasek
(The Order of Temasek) Rules 1996
In exercise of the powers conferred by rule 15 of the Darjah Utama Temasek (The Order of Temasek) Rules 1975 (G.N. No. S 186/75), the President annuls the said Rules and is pleased to approve the institution of an Order to be styled the Darjah Utama Temasek or the Order of Temasek, the award of which shall be governed by the following Rules:

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 9.
The Order of Temasek
OBVERSE
REVERSE
SEAL OF THE
ORDER OF TEMASEK
STAR OF THE ORDER OF TEMASEK
